exercises.title: Shortest path with costs
exercises.task: The priority queue is given (a container/heap, as in D10). Fill the three holes of ShortestPath: settle the closest node, relax its links, then rebuild the path from prev. Run shows why the fewest hops (BFS, A10) is not the cheapest route.
hints: Hole 1: if done[it.node] { continue }, then done[it.node] = true, and break if it is dst.
Hole 2: for each e in g[it.node], d := it.dist + e.Cost; if e.To has no distance yet or d is smaller, store dist, prev, and heap.Push(q, item{e.To, d}).
Hole 3: follow prev from dst until src, appending each node, then reverse the slice.
